The allowlist currently permits these sites:

- https://www.youtube.com
- https://en.wikipedia.org

Our system is designed to be robust against userinfo-based bypass attempts. When a URL is submitted, the fetcher parses the URL to extract the real host, which is the part after the `@` symbol if present. Only if this real host is on the allowlist will the fetcher proceed with the request.

For example, a URL like `http://github.com@evil.com` would be correctly identified as attempting to connect to `evil.com`, which is not on the allowlist, and thus the request would be blocked.

If you have specific URLs or patterns you'd like to test, feel free to share them, and I can help you understand how the system would handle them.
